question: T12 (task-f38983d37d8db815), after #759 (CAP-T12WAVEREFIT): do Fade edges, Item Spacing and Text Size move a Scrolling block's rows after a Wave Intensity fall that left its line running over, and does a Design press move the rows of a block made taller by hand? A new Scrolling block per plan on Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, Design tab. F: 180>90, Fade edges. G: 180>90, Item Spacing pressed on its range at 0.9 (0.5em to 2.7em). H: 180>90, Large text size. I: 120>0, Medium text size. J: the bottom handle pulled down 82 px (2 rows), Fade edges. K: the same pull, Animation speed 2x. Each plan read after every step and again after Escape (let go). R1 read F to K, R2 K to F: every plan in two sessions. Nothing saved, each session left by Exit Without Saving.
readsAre: layout: desktop and phone grid areas, rows (the section's row count), rowSizes, block (height), marquee and svg ([top in the block, height]), ctl (each Direction, Speed, Pause on hover, Fade edges and Text Size control's label and on state), value (the first range), ranges (each range: its label, value, min, max). The read's name is the session, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them.
answer: After a fall that left the line running over, Fade edges and Item Spacing move no rows, as Speed does (#759): 180>90 keeps 3 rows (1/2/4/26, block 124) through each.
Text Size refits the rows to the new line: Large after 180>90 takes 7 rows (1/2/8/26, block 277); Medium after 120>0 takes 3 rows (1/2/4/26, block 112.3, the line 93 high, 9.6 from its top).
A block made taller by hand (1/2/3/26 pulled to 1/2/5/26, the line 34 high, 59.7 from its top) keeps its rows at Fade edges and at Animation speed 2x.
R1 and R2 read alike in all 28 reads (areas, rows, block, line, controls on, ranges). The phone area stays 1/2/3/10 throughout.
Not read: Text Style; Text Size on a block made taller by hand; Item Spacing by a drag or the number box; the phone view.
